POPULAR TOURNAMENTS
Americano: Americano is a popular tournament format in padel where players compete in teams of two. It follows a round-robin format, where each team plays against every other team in the tournament. Mexicano offers a unique twist to traditional padel tournaments.

Mixicano: Mixicano is a fun and inclusive padel tournament format that promotes gender diversity and teamwork. Based on a predetermined number of points per game (e.g. 21 points) the team that takes the most number of points will be the winner of the match. Wireless Remote Control and Direct Control: 
Remotely operate your Ledlenser with the Connect app or with the Wireless Remote Control Type A (if compatible). Personalize your light settings:

Each profile allows you to configure up to six light features, such as light intensity, color, or other function (depending on your light). After sending the profile to the light, these features can then be set directly using the switch of the light – even without a smartphone. Available as in app purchase for HF8R Core/Work.


Light at the right time:

Keep an eye on time thanks to blinking

E.g. at a 10 minutes interval with smart blink, the light would be shortly interrupted one time after 10 minutes, then two times shortly interrupted after 20 minutes (= perceived as two times shortly blinking) and so on.
